Description:
[img]http://img06.deviantart.net/e804/i/2008/112/d/0/higurashi_no_naku_koro_ni_logo_by_darth_biomech.jpg[/img]

[b][i][u]Higurashi No Naku Koro Ni - Portrait and Character Mod

[/u][/i][/b]This mod replaces characters within Stardew Valley with characters from the Higurashi universe.
The mod includes both portraits and custom made sprites.

[img]http://i52.tinypic.com/34s5b1e.jpg[/img]

[u]Installation[/u]

Unpack the Higurashi Mod.rar and move the content folder to your Stardew Valley root folder.

Default - C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley

When prompted to replace the files as needed (Remember to make backups of any file this mod changes)
If you only want the portraits or sprites then only install and reaplace the "Portraits" or "Characters" respectedly
